body:
# 🛸 OrbitOmen's Utility Modpack

> **Minecraft 1.21.11 · Fabric 0.19.2 · 118 Mods · Client-Side Only**

A carefully curated client-side modpack built to make vanilla Minecraft look better, run faster, and feel smoother — without changing a single block of gameplay. Compatible with every vanilla server.

---

## ✨ What's Inside

### ⚡ Performance
Massive FPS gains and reduced stuttering thanks to the best-in-class optimization stack:
- **Sodium** + **Lithium** + **Krypton** — the holy trinity of Fabric performance
- **C2ME**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **FerriteCore** — memory and rendering efficiency
- **EntityCulling**, **MoreCulling** — stop rendering what you can't see
- **Dynamic FPS** — save resources when the game is in the background
- Dozens of micro-optimizers for minecarts, anchors, crossbows, knockback, PvP, and more

### 🎨 Visuals & Cosmetics
Vanilla never looked this good:
- **Iris Shaders** — full shader support
- **Entity Model & Texture Features** — custom entity models and textures
- **LambDynamicLights** — dynamic lighting in your hand
- **Animatica** + **Continuity** — animated textures and connected textures
- **BetterGrassify**, **Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks** — subtle world improvements
- Capes (**Capes**, **WaveyCapes**, **Cosmetica**), glowing trims, visual armor trims
- Curated resource packs: anime sky overlays, Solo Leveling inventory GUI, detailed animations, eating animations, teddy totems, PvP crosshair, and more

### 🗺️ HUD & Interface
Always know what's going on:
- **Xaero's World Map** + **wWaypoints** — never get lost again
- **AppSkin** — see hunger/saturation values on food
- **ShulkerBox Tooltip** — preview shulker contents without opening
- **Health Indicators** — see mob health
- **Armor HUD**, **Shield Status** — equipment at a glance
- **Better Advancements**, **ModMenu**, **Reese's Sodium Options** — cleaner menus

### 🔧 Quality of Life
Small changes, big difference:
- **Zoomify** — smooth, configurable zoom
- **ViaFabricPlus** — connect to older server versions
- **MouseTweaks** — smarter inventory management
- **Simple Voice Chat** — proximity voice on supported servers
- **Chat Heads**, **ChatNotify**, **Emoji Type** — better chat experience
- **FabrShot** — take hi-res screenshots
- **Language Reload**, **CommandKeys**, **KeepThatInventoryOpen**, and much more

---

## 🖥️ Client-Side Only
Every mod in this pack runs on the **client only**. You can join any vanilla server with no issues — no server-side installation required.

---
